items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: He said, Jim, do you feelin' alright? ... He says, I don't hear that tuba, Chink.

ctx.x: It was a Suzaphone, see. Is that a double B-flat?

No, E-flat. But it was a double E. It was a double E, see. Big one. Yeah. So, we got off in this special city. I don't remember where it was. And like I said, we got the plan to get the new delegates in there, you know. So, the band is playing. And I see old man Biles Stoffer. He's looking at me like that, you know. He's doing this, you see. He don't say nothing, you see. Got through playing. He said, Jim, do you feelin' alright? I said, yeah, why? He says, I don't know. He says, but I don't hear that tuba.
